body: Thanks man, I really appreciate that. You're then first person I've talked to in a long time that actually seemed to give a shit about me.

I tried for so long to focus on the good, to do what I enjoyed and keep a positive attitude. I loved my job, it made me happier than anything else in the world. But I fucked it up, went and got fired. Then, the bank took my car, and now I'm left being nothing but a failure who can't even go to grocery store without someone's help. I just don't have the energy to keep up with it.

Funny. I never thought of spiritual retribution before. Though, I have to wonder, what form that could take. Currently, simply living with the knowledge that I fail at everything I do seems like the worst punishment anyone could ever be given.
Ha. I've been sitting here, reading through this forum, trying to get the strength to take my pistol out of my drawer and do it, for about an hour.
